title: an invalid draft is rejected with every problem on one line, naming where it came from (stdin or the path as given), and nothing is written
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). The draft is checked with the build rules of the draft layer (the allowlists and route scope of this project, and the rules only a launch sees: a harness with an adapter, a listed subagent must exist). Every problem is reported, joined by `; `, as `JITSO REJECTED: draft <source> is invalid: <problems>` where the source is the path as given or `stdin`; the exit code is 2 and no file or folder is created. A file that is not a mapping, or not YAML, is rejected the same way.
